messages:
emma: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 1 leadership requested a single-thread summary: where are we on API v2 rollout timing, Console beta feature set, and Optimize quant advisor? Please include callouts for blockers and who owns next steps.

raj: TL;DR: API v2 canary target in ~5-7 weeks, GA target in ~11-13 weeks if no major issues. Console beta feature-freeze ~7 weeks, public beta ~9-10 weeks. Optimize advisor: pilot onboarding in the next 3-4 weeks; broad rollout contingent on pilot evals and privacy sign-offs.

tom: Quick risk notes for API v2: 1) SDK compatibility matrix incomplete (mobile SDKs not covered), 2) rate limiter under burst may return 429s that clients don't retry gracefully, 3) new error surface for streaming chunks. We found a KV-cache eviction path that can cause token churn on ~long chat sessions.

hana: Console beta details: included in beta - per-route cost visibility, simple rollout controls (canary + % rollout), quick prompts eval panel. Excluding deep-span tracing and advanced RBAC for this beta to keep scope tight. We'll document UX impacts for support.

leah: Action item for SDKs: I'll pull owners for JS, Python, and mobile; aim to complete smoke tests within 2 weeks. Need an explicit compatibility spec from API owners. @raj can you link the spec?

raj: Linking the API compatibility doc in the follow-up notes (will post link). Proposed compatibility gates: semver mapping, roundtrip schema checks, streaming chunk semantics, and a small abort/retry contract.

own: Optimize pilot ask: we need 2 pilot customers who can share anonymized prompt sets and accept offline eval runs. Without pilots in 3 weeks, earliest rollout slips a month. Also callout: advisor will be opt-in for customers and will expose a confidence score and expected latency/cost delta.

emma: Leadership note - if Console beta changes any default routing or model fallbacks, support needs clear bullet points. Also we need explicit SLOs: what's the latency target and error budget for API v2 during canary?

raj: SLO target for canary: p50 <60ms, p95 <200ms for text-gen endpoints on dedicated canary infra. Error budget: 0.5% unavailability over the soak window. We'll include these in the canary playbook.

tom: Regarding the KV cache bug repro: it's triggered by interleaved long and short sequences that force a partial KV invalidation. I'll drop a minimal repro script and a unit test example into the ticket tonight. Please plan a focused testcase in the regression suite.

leah: Noted. I'll add the KV test to the SDK smoke checklist and coordinate with QA to include it in the regression runs.

hana: For Console support notes: we'll provide a short FAQ covering visible UX diffs (cost breakdown labels, rollout controls, prompt eval panel) and a rollback doc for admins. PMs to review wording.

own: Privacy flag for Optimize pilots: if a customer requires additional anonymization we can run the evals only on hashed prompts, but that reduces fidelity. Need to know candidate preferences ASAP.

emma: OK: two asks from leadership: (1) owners confirm infra availability for a dedicated canary by EOD tomorrow, (2) product to surface 2 pilot candidates for Optimize by EOD next Friday. Any objections?

leah: I'll confirm infra availability and post in the ticket.

raj: No objections. I'll assemble the canary playbook draft (gates + rollback + fallback variants + SLOs) and schedule a readiness review in 10 business days. Will invite SDK, infra, SRE, QA, and product.

deploy-bot: [placeholder] API v2 tentative canary slot reserved: 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-22 UTC. This will be finalized after gating checklist is green.

tom: One more note: canary should exercise both hosted traffic patterns and dedicated peak bursts. If dedicated infra limited, we'll reduce concurrency and extend the soak.

emma: Great. Please drop the playbook link, the KV repro, SDK smoke test list, and pilot candidate names in the all-hands follow-up doc. Ping me if anything shifts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
